edge_explainer.market_believes: Ollie's is a low-income-consumer casualty — cut the multiple until the strain shows up in the numbers.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The business is sound (rich closeout supply, honest cash pile, real unit runway) but the de-rate is substantially RATIONAL — flat traffic, a sales cut dressed as an EPS raise, and the value cohort's laggard print. We'll own it at prices that pre-pay those facts, with most powder held for December when other people's tax-loss selling hands us the fill.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Calendar discipline: knowing the November supply wave is coming — because we built the scanner that hunts it — and refusing to compete with our own future liquidity event.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: 16.8x already prices deceleration; the re-rate needs a >=2% comp with positive traffic to be EARNED.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: The ~early-September Q2 print (comp + traffic + any second guide action); the Nov-Dec tax-loss window; the IEEPA/SCOTUS tariff ruling (free option).
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Comp under 1% or negative traffic = the strain bear was right — kill, don't average.

_common.SLICE_WIDE_TAX_FINDING: ZERO of the 11 held positions in this slice has reached its one-year mark. Earliest long-term dates: BAH and J on 2027-05-27; the July cohort (BKE/IBEX/EQT/HCA/LDOS/OLLI) on 2027-07-07..14; III 2027-07-17; CI 2027-07-23; PRCT 2027-07-25. Every upside trim resting today therefore prices in SHORT-TERM dollars at ~50%, roughly double the long-term drag. This is a level input, not a reason to skip the band: a trim that only clears on strength is still wrong-side-safe, but the rungs below were set at court BULL/ceiling values (not base values) partly for this reason.
_common.wrong_side_test: Every rung below is a SELL limit ABOVE the market; it can only fill on strength, so it cannot fill on the thesis-killer. Downside kills are ALERT-class only -- no resting stops anywhere in this slice (a stop is the sell-side fills-on-the-cut trap).
